hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Calculate greatest common divisor of pair multiplied by sum of both values.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Track and return the maximum pair strength observed.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
import math

def maxPairStrengthGCD(nums: list[int]) -> int:
    n = len(nums)
    best = 0
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i + 1, n):
            g = math.gcd(nums[i], nums[j])
            best = max(best, g * (nums[i] + nums[j]))
    return best
```
